governingStatute: Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (Title 26, U.S. Code)
title: Foreign Tax Credit authorization, separate basket limitation, and partnership pass-through reporting (Form 1116 / Schedule K-3)
plainTextSummary: A taxpayer claiming a foreign tax credit under 26 U.S.C. § 901 based on partnership pass-through items reported on IRS Form 1065 Schedule K-1 Box 21 must substantiate the claim with Schedule K-3 (Partner Share of International Income and Taxes). Box 21 alone does not establish legal compliance. Form 1116 separate basket limitation calculations (26 U.S.C. § 904(d)), passive activity limits (26 U.S.C. § 469), and country-by-country breakdown are statutory prerequisites before the credit may be claimed on federal income tax returns.

keyStatutoryThresholds.statutoryRequirement: Schedule K-3 mandatory supporting attachment for amounts exceeding de minimis thresholds.
